short: binary-level integration tests with a fake gh and a fake curl
is: Integration tests that run the built zaf binary in a temp project against a scripted fake gh or fake curl and, for slices, a throwaway jj repository with a bare remote; the ways_*.rs crates run the ways repository's own actions through `zaf do`, and the pack_*.rs crates check the teams pack's files. Three crates read no binary: architecture.rs holds the layers to their imports, board_contract.rs checks every Board backend the same way, and forge_contract.rs takes one pull request through the Forgejo forge on a real instance.
conventions: Each test crate does `mod common;` and builds a Project (temp root, .zaf.toml, gh scene) from common/mod.rs

fs.name: architecture.rs
fs.role: each layer names only the crate modules it may; the domain names none outside itself

fs.name: board_contract.rs
fs.role: the Board contract over an Arrange trait: always on FakeBoard, on GitHub issues when ZAF_CONTRACT_REPO names a scratch repo (and a Project with ZAF_CONTRACT_PROJECT), on Forgejo when ZAF_CONTRACT_FORGEJO_URL, _REPO and _TOKEN_ENV name an instance, a scratch repo and the variable holding its token

fs.name: cli_ask.rs
fs.role: zaf ask: the instance it reads from the environment

fs.name: cli_begin.rs
fs.role: zaf begin on the built binary: no terminal, exit 2 with one sentence

fs.name: cli_board.rs
fs.role: board verbs: terse and JSON forms, exits 0, 1, 2

fs.name: cli_brief.rs
fs.role: zaf brief: the ## Actions section, and the instance and zaf home it reads from the environment

fs.name: cli_forge.rs
fs.role: zaf forge verbs on a GitHub forge (fake gh) and a Forgejo one (fake curl): what each prints, exits 0, 1, 2

fs.name: cli_progress.rs
fs.role: zaf progress: the phases a model declares and reports, and the hub report each call leaves

fs.name: cli_slice.rs
fs.role: slice open, changes, slice pr, slice merge end to end

fs.name: common/
fs.role: shared Project harness (command_of runs a copy of the binary), jj helper, the fake curl scene (Curl), path_with_zaf, which puts the built zaf on PATH for actions that call zaf, Running, a long-lived zaf whose output is gathered as it comes, killed when dropped, and scheduler_up, the scheduler lock held by the test's own process

fs.name: do_action.rs
fs.role: zaf do end to end, and the runner itself where a kill would take a minute; a temp project and a temp zaf home per run

fs.name: begin_build_stage.rs
fs.role: zaf begin at the build stage (signed documents, every open epic signed, one not done): on a pty under NO_COLOR it shows Build as the fourth stage and asks Q5's question; n prints the spawn line and exits 0, y execs `zaf spawn --watch --version <v>` (a stub zaf on PATH sees it)

fs.name: epic_sign_build.rs
fs.role: zaf epic sign asks to start the build when its signature is the last of the version's epics: on a pty, answered n and y (a stub zaf on PATH sees the exec), and quiet with another epic unsigned, inside an instance, with --json and with stdin closed

fs.name: doctor_actions.rs
fs.role: doctor reports every action with its validity and mode; an invalid file fails the report by file and line

fs.name: doctor_manifests.rs
fs.role: doctor fails on a retired ZAF.toml beside a new manifest file and names both

fs.name: fixtures/
fs.role: gh: fake gh shell script; forgejo/curl: fake curl for the Forgejo adapter; claude: a stand-in claude CLI that says it is logged in and does nothing else

fs.name: forge_contract.rs
fs.role: the Forgejo forge on a real instance when ZAF_CONTRACT_FORGEJO_URL, _REPO and _TOKEN_ENV are set: a new branch, a pull request opened, a pending then a passing status, the hand-off, the merge; the branch deleted after

fs.name: gate_action.rs
fs.role: a [gate] line that names an action (`zaf do gate-light`) runs as any line, in the task's workspace

fs.name: ways_forgejo_release.rs
fs.role: Forgejo's release workflow makes the release a draft from an encoder's JSON of the tag's message, attaches install.sh with the tag's version and publishes last

fs.name: git_e2e.rs
fs.role: a plain git repository (git init, a bare origin, the fake Forgejo curl, a fake claude) set up by zaf setup, doctor passing, takes one ticket from ready to merged through implement, ci, review and merge by zaf spawn phase; no jj or gh on the path

fs.name: hub_dashboard.rs
fs.role: zaf hub --port <n>: a port that is taken is refused by name

fs.name: hub_tick.rs
fs.role: POST /api/tick through the built binary: a project with one ready task and a fake runner has it started, and the answer names it

fs.name: hub_watch.rs
fs.role: POST /api/watch through the built binary: the watch's first tick starts the ready task while the hub holds the scheduler lock, and a stop ends the watch

fs.name: install_script.rs
fs.role: install.sh under sh with fake uname, sysctl, git, curl, tar and claude on a PATH of its own and a temp HOME: the first screen, each step 1 refusal, a script cut in half

fs.name: local_manifest.rs
fs.role: .zaf/local.toml as the manifest's top layer: its slots win, any other manifest setting fails a verb

fs.name: pack_actions.rs
fs.role: the teams pack's 25 standard actions: every file executable and a valid action

fs.name: pack_briefs.rs
fs.role: the pack's six role briefs open with the exact bytes of zaf's interface page

fs.name: pack_designer.rs
fs.role: the pack's two Designer actions (design, review-epic) run with stand-ins for zaf and claude

fs.name: profile_stale.rs
fs.role: a profile older than the manifest or zaf: spawn refuses it, doctor fails on it, status names it, each with the same line

fs.name: projects_list.rs
fs.role: the zaf home's project list: a project joins once, on its first verb or on setup

fs.name: release_open.rs
fs.role: the release-open action: opens the version's release pull request through a fake forge, hands an open one back, refuses without the branch on the remote

fs.name: report_ledger.rs
fs.role: the ledger: `zaf report` and `zaf spawn --once` fill it

fs.name: setup_e2e.rs
fs.role: zaf setup from an empty folder: asks for the manifest, writes it, installs the pack's actions, generates the profiles

fs.name: setup_homes.rs
fs.role: the two homes: what setup makes, what every other verb makes first, and the .zaf/.gitignore allow-list as git check-ignore sees it

fs.name: setup_move.rs
fs.role: a root ZAF.toml moves to .zaf.toml only when the Engineer runs zaf setup, once; every other verb reads it

fs.name: spawn_hooks.rs
fs.role: the tick's hooks: .zaf/actions/hooks/pre-tick runs first, and one that exits non-zero ends the tick

fs.name: spawn_no_wait.rs
fs.role: spawn --once --no-wait exits 0 at once while another tick holds spawn.lock; plain --once keeps waiting

fs.name: spawn_phase.rs
fs.role: spawn phase: the caller does not wait, the run sees ZAF_RUN, ZAF_SIZE and ZAF_INSTANCE, a non-current or running phase is refused, a started phase reads Running, two starts never go one over the slots; the launcher records the head the phase left (empty with no pull request, none when unreadable) before the exit, a question asked inside the run is recorded in it, and the phase's end asks the running scheduler for a tick, or ticks itself with none

fs.name: spawn_placement.rs
fs.role: the JSON dry run's `placement`: each open ticket with a phase list placed by the core (in the lane, waiting on a dependency); the plain-text dry run unchanged and reading nothing for it

fs.name: spawn_stop.rs
fs.role: spawn stop <task>: ends the instance and its group and releases the claim; no live instance is refused

fs.name: spawn_trace.rs
fs.role: the trace: a real tick appends where every ticket sits and prints each move and a count (--more every ticket), a dry run writes none, lines past 14 days are dropped, an unwritable trace warns and the tick succeeds, a tick that cannot gather leaves an error line, and a scheduler's tick that cannot read the facts keeps its last placement and starts nothing; `zaf spawn trace` oldest first, one ticket, --since, no file exits 0

fs.name: spawn_unblock.rs
fs.role: the tick's unblocking: a blocked task whose blockers are all done, one case of the label sync

fs.name: watch_view.rs
fs.role: `spawn --watch` under a pseudo-terminal: piped and --json stream as today and write no log; in a terminal frames are redrawn in place (cursor up, clear) with no tick text block, the tick's text and warnings land in .zaf/logs/scheduler.log, a failed tick is one line naming it, and Ctrl-C leaves the terminal's settings as they were

fs.name: spawn_watch.rs
fs.role: the scheduler (`spawn --watch`): a fresh one opens the build first (refused on an unsigned design or no remote, the lock freed; a restart skips it), then ticks at once and when asked, never on the timer here; one lock, a second scheduler named and refused, a dead one's line taken over; `--once` and the verbs ask it, and a ruling or a signature that cannot ask still stands and says so; a new binary restarted into as the same pid, one that does not run named and kept out; SIGINT and SIGTERM end it after its tick with the lock released; a built version (every epic done) says `zaf built <v>: release pull request #<n>, <link>` once, piped, and the watch goes on

fs.name: spawn_zaf_step.rs
fs.role: the tick's zaf-kind step: a task's ready zaf-kind action run in its own process

fs.name: ways_base_up.rs
fs.role: the base-up action: brings a branch up to its base

fs.name: ways_ci.rs
fs.role: the CI workflow runs for every change to the actions and the manifest, not only to the crate

fs.name: ways_ci_wait.rs
fs.role: the ci-wait action: waits for a pull request's checks to settle at its head

fs.name: ways_commit.rs
fs.role: the commit action: commits a slice's work in its workspace

fs.name: ways_fix_merge.rs
fs.role: a merge whose base conflicts starts fix, and the fix round can bring the base in

fs.name: ways_forbidden.rs
fs.role: the manifest's [forbidden] list keeps every instance from merging outside `zaf do slice-merge` and `zaf do release`

fs.name: ways_gitignore.rs
fs.role: .zaf/ is committed under the allow-list zaf setup writes

fs.name: ways_issue_file.rs
fs.role: the issue-file action: files an issue under an epic, its body from a file

fs.name: ways_land.rs
fs.role: the land action (`land <pr>`, over pr-merge)

fs.name: ways_manifest.rs
fs.role: the ways repo's own .zaf.toml loads, ZAF.toml is gone, and doctor finds every needed action in the project tier with no machine dependency

fs.name: ways_merge_base.rs
fs.role: the merge-base action: fetches and merges the base, or with --probe only answers whether it merges cleanly

fs.name: ways_pr_merge.rs
fs.role: the pr-merge action: a merge commit or a squash

fs.name: ways_pr_open.rs
fs.role: the pr-open action: opens a slice's pull request and hands the number back

fs.name: ways_push.rs
fs.role: the push action: moves a slice's bookmark forward

fs.name: ways_release.rs
fs.role: the release action: checks zaf/Cargo.toml, then the three steps it composes

fs.name: ways_release_workflow.rs
fs.role: the GitHub release workflow: a draft with the tag's commit message as notes, install.sh uploaded with the tag's version, then published

fs.name: ways_ship.rs
fs.role: the ship action (`ship <bookmark> <base> <title>`)

fs.name: ways_slice.rs
fs.role: the slice-open, slice-pr and slice-drop actions

fs.name: ways_steps.rs
fs.role: every file in .zaf/actions/ has valid metadata and its designed mode, and doctor reports none as a problem

fs.name: ways_sync.rs
fs.role: the sync action: fetches and starts a new change on the base

fs.name: ways_tag.rs
fs.role: the tag action (`tag <name> [rev]`)

fs.name: ways_task_pr.rs
fs.role: the task-pr action: hands back a task's pull request

fs.name: ways_workspace_drop.rs
fs.role: the workspace-drop action: forgets a slice's workspace

fs.name: ways_workspace_open.rs
fs.role: the workspace-open action: makes a slice's workspace

notes: fixtures/gh reads a FAKE_GH_DIR scene: a rules file of glob, exit code and response file; calls/ records each argv; an unmatched call exits 97
src/adapters/github/tests.rs also uses fixtures/gh, so it is shared with unit tests

fixtures/forgejo/curl reads a FAKE_CURL_DIR scene: a rules file of a glob over METHOD URL, an HTTP status (or curl:<code>; a trailing ! answers once) and response file; calls/ records each argv and the config curl read on stdin; src/adapters/forgejo/tests.rs, cli_forge.rs and ways_ci_wait.rs use it
board_contract.rs and forge_contract.rs reach the network only when their variables are set: gh for GitHub, the Forgejo instance for Forgejo
cli_slice needs a real jj on PATH
